items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: During that same period of which we are speaking, which Cuban musicians played jazz in Cuba?

Well, the musicians in Cuba were complete because those that dedicated themselves to accompany shows had to be a complete musician. They could not be limited because they had to play all kinds of music. So there were – they brought artists who had something to do with jazz music. So there were many good musicians, on any instrument needed. If they had to play jazz, the musician had to be good. So they always would work on excelling because they knew they had to play all kinds of music. They did not know what…
This means that in Cuba there was a jazz movement too?
